Bar of jurisdiction 57. No court shall entertain a suit in respect of anything done under this Act by the University of Turbat.
Removal of difficulties 58. If any difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provisions of this Act, the Government may make such order as appears necessary. SCHEDULE THE FIRST STATUE OF THE UNIVERSITY OF TURBAT 1, Faculties. There shall be a Faculty of Arts and a Board of each Faculty, and the Dean shall be the head of that Faculty.
